scope: scripts/qualify_online_routes.py --skip-snapshots --skip-upload from commit 94d7c49 (binaries built from 1c272fc; src identical) on one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN with simulation support and a global DB OnDb, downloaded to a fresh owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 instance whose protection credential was provisioned, in RUN: plc_online_compare with the instance's generated scratch runtime user answered exactly one OnlineAuthenticationConfiguration challenge (ProjectUser), stayed in RUN, completed its cleanup and found every compare row identical; typed refusals for an unknown ticket, the CPU's protection credential, runtime-user metadata naming another project or CPU, a copy outside scratch-credentials (InvalidSimulationCredential / SimulationLoginTargetMismatch) and no credential (SimulationOnlineAuthenticationRequired), each leaving the project unchanged; then stop, power off, owned release and unchanged preexisting TIA processes.
limitations: plc_station_upload is not qualified: in an empty Portal the upload meets TLS verification for the owned CPU, which these routes never trust (SimulationOnlineAuthenticationRequired, 29 October 2026).
The DB-snapshot routes are not qualified: after an online db_snapshot_create, V21's InterfaceSnapshot.Export returned the same value-less document as before, so the capture refused it.
Provisioning the protection credential trusts the owned, empty CPU's certificate on first use (trustOwnedEmptyCpuCertificate); the online route itself answers TLS NonTrusted.
TIA reuses an online login within the same Portal without a new challenge; later online sessions in that Portal answer none.
One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 instance on local Softbus; never a physical PLC.
